distance: Euclidean; preprocessing fitted on training objects in each evaluation split
bandwidth: distance to the (k+1)-th neighbor; truncated Gaussian over first k neighbors

evaluation.loo: Full-sample LOO for k and h tuning; scores at the minimum are descriptive, not independent
evaluation.external_cv: Stratified 5-fold CV with nested stratified 3-fold tuning of retained fraction and k; preprocessing and selection refitted within each split
evaluation.full_sample_selection: Descriptive visualization only; not used for external predictions
